description: The trigger for this skill covers phrasings such as "write the release notes", "draft a changelog", "what shipped in this version", and "summarise the commits since the last tag". It also covers a user who pastes a raw list of commits and asks what to do with them. Release notes, changelog, ship note, and version summary are all in range of the trigger.
